narration: Beside Pooja's amounts sits a column of employee codes. Those are text too.
caption: पूजा की रकमों के बग़ल में कर्मचारी कोड का कॉलम है — वे भी टेक्स्ट हैं
image_brief: A row of stamped metal employee badges hanging on a rail above a tray of loose currency notes on a locker room bench, cool overhead light.

narration: One code reads zero zero seven four two. Two of its characters are zeros.
caption: एक कोड ऐसा पढ़ा जाता है: ज़ीरो ज़ीरो सात चार दो
image_brief: A punched metal tag stamped 00742 hanging from a hook on a workshop board among empty hooks, angled work light on the stamped grooves.

narration: Convert it and Excel stores seven hundred and forty-two instead.
caption: उसे बदल दें तो एक्सेल उसकी जगह सात सौ बयालीस रख लेता है
image_brief: The same metal tag lying on an anvil, re-stamped to read 742 with the two leading zeros hammered flat into the surface, hard bench light.

narration: Both zeros are gone, with no warning. Payroll now points at a stranger.
caption: दोनों ज़ीरो ग़ायब, कोई चेतावनी नहीं — पेरोल अब किसी अजनबी पर लगा है
image_brief: A payroll envelope on an office desk with an unfamiliar name showing through its address window, a tray of other envelopes behind it, plain office light.

narration: The same trap arrives with long digits. Excel keeps fifteen significant digits, no more.
caption: वही जाल लंबे अंकों के साथ आता है: एक्सेल पंद्रह सार्थक अंक ही रखता है
image_brief: A long paper strip printed with a run of sixteen digits stretched across a table, the final digit fading into blank paper, even daylight along the strip.

narration: A sixteen-digit account number quietly loses its final digit to a zero.
caption: सोलह अंकों का अकाउंट नंबर चुपचाप अपना आख़िरी अंक ज़ीरो कर देता है
image_brief: A card-sized metal plate on a bank counter with its last digit position replaced by an empty blank slot, a rubber stamp lying beside it, counter light.

narration: A label like three point ten becomes three point one. Some codes become dates.
caption: 3.10 जैसा लेबल 3.1 बन जाता है, और कुछ कोड तारीख़ बन जाते हैं
image_brief: Three parcel labels lined up on a sorting bench, one reading 3.10, the next reading 3.1, the third printed as a calendar date, bright sorting room light.

narration: So the rule is short. If you never do arithmetic on it, leave it text.
caption: नियम छोटा है: जिस पर गणित नहीं करते, उसे टेक्स्ट ही रहने दें
image_brief: A wooden signboard at a fork in a country road, one arm painted DO ARITHMETIC and the other LEAVE AS TEXT, wide open afternoon light.

narration: Identifiers are text on purpose. That is not a defect waiting for your repair.
caption: पहचान कोड जान-बूझकर टेक्स्ट होते हैं — यह सुधारने वाली ख़राबी नहीं है
image_brief: A rack of luggage tags hanging at a railway parcel office, each tag carrying a printed code and not one carrying a price, dim station light.

narration: The common mistake? Selecting the whole sheet and converting everything in one sweep.
caption: आम ग़लती? पूरी शीट चुनकर सब कुछ एक ही झटके में बदल देना
image_brief: A broad felt marker dragged in one long stroke right across an entire printed sheet of ruled cells on a desk, ink still glistening, sharp desk light.

narration: That repairs three cells and silently wrecks a whole column of codes. Worse than before.
caption: वह तीन सेल सुधारता है और चुपचाप कोड का पूरा कॉलम बरबाद कर देता है
image_brief: Three carefully mended cups standing on a shelf with a long row of shattered code tags scattered on the shelf below them, even light across both shelves.

narration: One more limit. A cleaned sheet stays clean only until the next export lands.
caption: एक और सीमा: साफ़ की हुई शीट अगले एक्सपोर्ट तक ही साफ़ रहती है
image_brief: A swept and empty workbench with an unopened wooden crate stencilled NEXT MONTH standing right beside it, plain storeroom light.

narration: If the file arrives monthly, set the column types during the import instead.
caption: फ़ाइल हर महीने आती है? तो इंपोर्ट के वक़्त ही कॉलम टाइप सेट करें
image_brief: An intake desk where each column of a form is marked with a type stamp before the papers are passed further along the counter, bright reception light.

narration: Try it now. Select one amount column and put COUNT beside COUNTA.
caption: अभी करके देखें: एक रकम कॉलम चुनें और COUNT के साथ COUNTA रखें
image_brief: An open workbook on a kitchen table with one column outlined in pencil and two fresh formulas written at its foot, morning light across the page.

narration: If they disagree, your total was never wrong. It was answering a smaller question.
caption: अगर दोनों अलग हैं, तो कुल ग़लत नहीं था — वह छोटे सवाल का जवाब दे रहा था
image_brief: A ledger page with its inked total on the bottom line and a single pencilled question mark added in the margin beside it, low lamp light.
